data.change_summary: Audited the pending habitat-registry amendments against the checked-out base, confirmed the preset/save plumbing and photoperiod-aware planted-tank DO regression were already wired in, and finished the remaining substrate-layer hardening by making `SubstrateLayerState::default()` derive its colonizable area from default geometry while treating non-positive `colonizable_area_factor` values as "use the layer kind default" before refresh persists an explicit factor. Updated the affected substrate-bearing test fixtures so current/legacy save handling and habitat recomputation stay aligned with the explicit substrate-factor model.
outstanding_risks: Validation was targeted, not full-workspace; I ran the affected core, scenario, and harness suites plus a broader `tank_core --tests --no-run`, but not the entire repository test matrix.

The worktree still contains unrelated pre-existing changes outside this task scope (including `crates/tank_core/src/systems/plant_growth.rs`, `crates/tank_data/src/*`, `crates/tank_tui/src/*`, `.ralph-burning/`, and `crates/tank_core/tests/plant_nutrient_normalization.rs`), which I left untouched.
Targeted builds still emit unrelated existing warnings in `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs` about unused normalization helpers/arguments.

steps.description: Inspected the current substrate serialization/refresh paths and the pending light-window regression to separate already-landed fixes in the checked-out base from the remaining default/fallback bug.

Hardened substrate-layer defaults so derived colonizable area comes from default geometry and non-positive serialized area factors fall back to the layer kind default, then aligned the affected substrate-bearing test fixtures with the explicit factor field.
Revalidated the touched save/load, habitat, substrate, scenario-materialization, and planted-tank DO paths with targeted cargo test runs.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_registry --test save_load --test plant_algae_integration --test rooted_substrate_advantage --test substrate_filter_integration` passed (32 habitat tests, 27 save/load tests, 8 plant/algae tests, 1 rooted-substrate test, 4 substrate/filter tests).
`cargo test -p tank_scenarios --test materialization --test startup_overrides` passed (9 materialization tests, 4 startup-override tests).
`cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_baseline_scenarios do_dips_at_night_in_planted_tank` passed (1 test).
